∀ {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ)
  (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (π : Ξ → Ω),
  Measurable π →
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map π Q = P →
      ∀ (F : Ω → ℝ),
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F P →
          (MeasureTheory.Integrable F P → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ => F (π ξ)) Q) ∧
            ∫ (ξ : Ξ), F (π ξ) ∂Q = ∫ (ω : Ω), F ω ∂P
